name: Convergence L / E / Li · Death · Fire
primary:
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning + 2.25 ❤ earth + 2 ❤ fire (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 2.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Knockback
• Breaks up to 8 blocks within 0.72 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Heals 1.75 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Growth: up to 5 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Rooted in place for 4.5 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)

• Slowness I for 8.25 s
• Heals 1.75 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4.5 s
